Class 1 Driver – Regional (Home Daily)
Granitefield Freight Lines Ltd. – Abbotsford, BC

Who we are
Granitefield Freight Lines Ltd. is a fictional, employee-focused carrier that has moved freight across Western Canada for more than 40 years. With 600 team members, 14 terminals and a modern fleet of late-model tractors, we are committed to safety, service and integrity in everything we do. Our people are our greatest asset, and we are proud to have been recognized as one of the region's top employers five years running.

The opportunity
We are seeking a safety-minded Class 1 Driver to run regional routes between our Abbotsford terminal and customers in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley. You will be home every night.

Key responsibilities
• Complete thorough pre-trip and post-trip inspections and report defects
• Safely operate tractor-trailer units in all weather and road conditions
• Load and secure freight, including tarping and chaining when required
• Keep accurate hours of service records on the electronic logging device (ELD)
• Deliver freight on time and provide professional service to customers
• Follow all company policies, Transport Canada and provincial regulations

Qualifications
• Valid Class 1 driver's licence with air brake endorsement
• Minimum 2 years of verifiable Class 1 tractor-trailer experience
• Clean driver's abstract (no more than 2 moving violations in the last 3 years)
• TDG (Transportation of Dangerous Goods) certificate, or willing to obtain
• Able to pass a pre-employment drug and alcohol test
• Able to cross the border is an asset

What we offer
• Competitive mileage and hourly pay, plus safety bonuses
• Comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits from day one
• Group RRSP with company matching
• Late-model, well-maintained equipment

Privacy notice
By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal information for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy legislation and retained for a period of 12 months.

Accommodation
Granitefield Freight Lines Ltd. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Diversity and inclusion
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, or disability.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
No agencies please.
